title: Generic resource graph productization roadmap
goal: Turn the completed generic resource graph proof expansion into a product-facing machinen move path for only exact target-native rows that have support, refusal, inventory, docs, coverage, and retained-artifact evidence. Keep proof-only same-arch continuation, cross-arch semantic reconstruction, broad service/database/process movement, source-fd teleportation, source-ISA emulation, metadata-only success, runtime-profile shortcuts, and arbitrary process restore explicitly out of product support unless a later goal proves a narrower product contract.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove every completed full-expansion proof row is classified as product-candidate, proof-only, refusal-only, or deferred, with a recorded reason and exact non-claims for same-arch continuation, cross-arch semantic reconstruction, broad service/database/process movement, source-fd teleportation, source-ISA emulation, and metadata-only success.

Counts are product-candidate=4 (generic-finite-pipe-buffer-replay, generic-stdio-pipe-product-marker, generic-service-redis-idle-parity, redis-live-generic-primary-marker), proof-only=3 (generic-service-process-tree-prefork, generic-same-arch-modeled-continuation, generic-cross-arch-semantic-reconstruction), refusal-only=14, and deferred=7. Product-candidate classification is explicitly advisory and does not itself promote routing; product use still requires exact-live-capture productPath metadata, refusalClasses=[], support/refusal pairings, target health/output evidence, inventory/docs registration, and retained proof coverage.
